analysis.summary: Crestchem Limited released its annual report for the financial year 2025-26, highlighting a total income of Rs. 25.52 crores and a net profit of Rs. 2.71 crores on a standalone basis. The company incorporated a subsidiary, Oleo Biosciences Private Limited, to set up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil. Management expects commercial production of the new MCT project to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27, subject to successful completion and statutory approvals.

guidance.claim: The company expects commercial production of the MCT Oil project to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.
guidance.quote: Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.

demand_outlook.claim: The global and Indian MCT market continues to witness healthy growth driven by increasing consumer awareness.
demand_outlook.quote: The global and Indian MCT market continues to witness healthy growth due to increasing consumer awareness regarding preventive healthcare, ketogenic diets, sports nutrition and functional foods.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for MCT Oil continues to grow due to health consciousness and expanding clinical applications.
demand_outlook.quote: The global demand for MCT Oil continues to grow, driven by increasing health consciousness, expanding applications in clinical and functional nutrition, and rising demand for premium specialty ingredients.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited as a subsidiary with a 75% equity participation to manufacture Medium Chain Triglyceride Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its long-term growth strategy, the Company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited, Bengaluru, as its subsidiary with an equity participation of 75% for setting up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil, a high-value specialty product catering to pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and personal care industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Procurement and installation of plant, machinery, and utilities for the MCT project are presently in progress.
capex_expansion.quote: The procurement and installation of plant and machinery, utilities and other equipment for the project are presently in progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively planning to expand and invest in new or startup businesses in limited liability partnership firms within specialty chemicals.
capex_expansion.quote: As was reported in previous financial year’s Annual Report the Company is now actively planning to expand and invest in new/start up business in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms, within our Speciallity Chemicals and related fields of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: A requisite pilot plant facility for new products is likely to be established by the company at the LLP firms in due course.
capex_expansion.quote: Accordingly, requisite pilot plant facility, for such products, is likely to be established by our company at such LLP firms, in due Course.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest in new or startup businesses or limited liability partnership firms within the chemical and related fields of operations.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is planning to invest in new/start up business- limited liability partnership firm(s), within our overall chemical and related field of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company assigned project work to a CSIR entity and is hopeful for a pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review company has assigned the Project Work to one of the entites of CSIR. Company is hopeful for pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.

margins_costs.claim: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.
margins_costs.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has proposed an investment, loans, or guarantees up to an aggregate amount of Rs. 2.75 Crores in its subsidiary company.
capital_allocation.quote: RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 186(3) and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, consent of members be and is hereby accorded to the Board to invest, give loans or guarantees up to an aggregate amount of Rs.2.75 Crores proposed investment in subsidiary, notwithstanding that the same limits within the permissible limits under Section 186.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors recommended a final dividend of Rs 1 (10%) per equity share of Rs 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: 2. To declare a final dividend of Rs 1/- (10%) per equity share of Rs. 10/- each, for the financial year ended March 31,2025

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no borrowings from any bank or institution and is debt free.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has no borrowings from any Bank or any Institution. There are no outstanding interest payments. Our company is debt free.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors recommended a 5% maiden dividend for the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors recommended 5% Maiden Dividend for the year 2023-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management notes potential execution risks including procurement timelines, installation schedules, and regulatory approvals.
risks_headwinds.quote: As the project is currently under implementation, the Company continues to monitor project execution risks, including procurement timelines, installation and commissioning schedules, availability of utilities, regulatory approvals, cost escalations and market conditions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disturbances from international events like Covid-19 and the Ukraine war affected the company, with prolonged ill effects and supply chain disruptions continuing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company. The prolonged ill effects including disturbances in the supply chain and such other disturbances continued till the date of this report.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that it is difficult to predict the implications of continued disturbances and thus project an outlook.
risks_headwinds.quote: The implication of such continued disturbances is difficult to predict and hence it is difficult to project an outlook. As such it may not be possible at this point of time to provide business out look for our Company and Industry in general.

risks_headwinds.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

risks_headwinds.quote: The implication of such continued disturbances is difficult to predict and hence it is difficult to project an outlook. As such it may not be possible at this point of time to provide business outlook for our Company and Industry in general.

management_commitments.quote: Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.
